$Comment: The defeat beat, whole: when the Target sensor loses the boss, clear the bar, stop the music,
release the slot, send zc:defeated and move to the state Next points at. Reference it as the
last instruction of the fight's final phase:
The library settles credit the instant the boss's death lands, so the beat here is the fallback
for a fight with no bound boss and the authoritative place the bar comes down. A zc:defeated
beat without a ClearEncounterBossBar beside it fails the content audit, because a dead boss's
bar otherwise stays on every screen until the corpse is removed.

Slot.Description: The target slot holding the boss.

Range.Description: How far the boss may be from the encounter entity to still count as present.
